toolbox.title: Creation Tools
toolbox.intro: Choose a tool to help create and debug your projects.
toolbox.encodingHint: Convert text into UTF-8 hex escapes and Galaxy code.
toolbox.localHint: Conversion runs locally. Input is never uploaded or saved.
toolbox.placeholder: Enter text to convert, e.g. 测试
toolbox.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select and copy the result manually.
toolbox.archiveValidationHint: Inspect standards, descriptor fields and automatic recognition.
toolbox.validationReadOnly: Reads archive listings and descriptors locally only. No extraction to disk, installation, game file changes or uploads. This is not an integrity or security scan.
toolbox.archiveOnly: Select a ZIP, 7z or RAR archive
toolbox.oneArchive: Drop one archive at a time
toolbox.dropArchive: Drop or select an archive to validate
toolbox.noFields: No descriptor fields could be read
toolbox.autoRulesHint: Uses the current installer recognition rules. Descriptors may disable automatic recognition; this does not mean standard package validation failed.
